title: Higher-Order Quadripolar Argumentation Framework and Encoded Semantics
summary: This paper introduces the Higher-Order Quadripolar Argumentation Framework (HQAF), which extends bipolar frameworks by allowing attacks and three types of supports---necessary, deductive, and evidential---to interact at higher order. In HQAF, each interaction may have as its source and target an argument, an attack, or a support.
